unit_basis: Pinned installed DCMI getter computes count*20/(ms/1000)/2**30; the cumulative counter convention is cross-checked against sampled getter rates in six known-payload phases.

request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

limitations: Driver-accounted link bytes include protocol traffic; not tensor payload or an independent physical-line capture.
TX is summed across two directions; peer RX is not added again.
Getter sampling covers approximately half of each interior phase; the cross-check is not a full-volume integration.
16 MiB synchronous reference does not cover all model payload sizes or graph execution; it is not substituted for a matched whole-model communication reference.
No whole-model effective FLOPs or M01 attainment is claimed.
